pages.title: Galleria Centercity
pages.extract: Galleria Centercity is a department store in Cheonan, South Korea. Its curved glass facade is a media facade of 22,000 LED pixels designed by UNStudio, completed in 2010.

pages.title: Media facade
pages.extract: A media facade is a facade of a building used as a large display. Media facades use LED technology.

pages.title: ExampleLED
pages.extract: ExampleLED is a company that manufactures media facade systems and LED screens. It was founded in 2001 by two engineers.

pages.title: Cheonan
pages.extract: Cheonan is a city in South Chungcheong Province, South Korea. The Galleria Centercity department store with its media facade is a landmark of the city.

pages.title: Fixture Artist B
pages.extract: Fixture Artist B is a German artist known for media facade works on buildings.

pages.title: Uniqa Tower
pages.extract: The Uniqa Tower is a 75 m office building in Vienna, Austria. Its glass skin carries a media facade of 40,000 LEDs that shows animations at night.
